payload.clusters: INHERIT the eight i3 clusters and their homes unchanged. The delta allocates INTO them, no new cluster: loop-parallel-serve + child completion + inherit acceptance -> PacketService/TokenEngine (loop.ts, machine.ts); schema + dotpath -> the apply lane (apply.ts); dotfile + roots + rename + plan ops + canvas ops -> the file/ledger lanes (deliverable.ts, apply.ts, a link index beside the warm index); grace + measured ETAs -> LawGuards/Record (toll.ts, calllog.ts + the mcp.ts decorate hook); json-tree + branches + maximize + scroll + log both-directions -> Surface (se-board.ts); canary -> the shim (se-mcp.ts); scorer + glossary + audits -> process + one packet seam (the scorer spawns OUTSIDE the engine, reads the evidence, writes one row through the normal submit lane - no engine element gains state).
